newsitem.title: USA: Ukraine needs budget, tax, corruption reform - IMF.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine needs budget, tax, corruption reform - IMF.

text.p: Ukraine needed to make reforms to its budget and tax system and attack corruption problems, a senior International Monetary Fund official said on Tuesday.
"There's a lot of reforms they need to undertake," IMF deputy managing director Stanley Fischer told Reuters Financial Television.
Fischer also said the IMF was close to agreeing with Ukraine on a revised version of an extended fund facility. He gave no details.
"They need to get their budget on track, they need to get their tax system far more under control and there is an issue of corruption in Ukraine," he said.
"There's an issue of corruption in many countries but its particularly marked in the Ukrainian case."
